workbook_path: data/Hungry F&B Database.Public Access 2026-10-17 Verified Menu Catalogue Refresh 40.xlsx
method: Checked direct merchant and landlord/venue policy sources for exact current SFA addresses and units. SFA listing alone was not treated as access proof. Conclusions distinguish explicit guest rules from public-dining evidence and inference.

records.name: OTTO RISTORANTE

evidence.supports: Exact address/unit match, consumer reservation pathway, and ordinary visitor route.

evidence.supports: Landlord directory confirms the restaurant tenant and public dining function.

records.name: RASA ISTIMEWA RESTAURANT
records.sfa_address: 333 Boon Lay Way #2B-01, SAFRA Jurong Club, Singapore 649848
records.access_conclusion: not_independently_public; requires member accompaniment/sign-in under located SAFRA guest policy; exclude from public-access catalogue pending contrary current policy

evidence.source: SAFRA reciprocal-arrangement policy for SAFRA facilities, guests, HomeTeamNS and NSRCC members
evidence.excerpt: 'ALL GUESTS MUST BE ACCOMPANIED BY EITHER SAFRA, HOMETEAMNS OR NSRCC MEMBERS.' The SAFRA Jurong table lists Rasa Istimewa Restaurant and says guests pay prevailing rates.
evidence.supports: Direct guest-entry requirement applies to SAFRA Jurong facilities/vendors, including Rasa Istimewa; a non-member cannot independently enter as an unaccompanied guest under this policy.

evidence.source: SAFRA official Rasa Istimewa tenant page
evidence.excerpt: Lists Rasa Istimewa Restaurant at SAFRA Jurong, its hours, reservation phone, and SAFRA Members' Benefit / Affiliated Members' Benefit.
evidence.supports: Confirms exact restaurant within SAFRA Jurong and member benefits; does not establish independent public clubhouse entry.

evidence.source: Merchant official Rasa Istimewa SAFRA Jurong page
evidence.excerpt: Identifies 333 Boon Lay Way, SAFRA Jurong Building #2B-01; explains SAFRA and affiliated member-card benefits.
evidence.supports: Exact SFA unit crosswalk; merchant's membership discount terms do not override SAFRA guest-entry policy.

records.held_reason: Although the venue has a public Oddle order page and advertises dine-in reservations, ordering availability does not prove physical independent access into a members' clubhouse. SAFRA's current located policy requires all guests to be accompanied by a member. Hold its Public Access Status and exclude it from the user-requested public-only list unless SAFRA confirms public walk-in entry without member sign-in.
